Phoenix Downtempo Ride

Phoenix, AZ · Downtown · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Phoenix Downtempo Ride is a social group ride in Phoenix, AZ. It rolls every Monday at 8:00 pm from Civic Space Park. Pace: slow, around 8 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @phxdowntemporide the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Phoenix Downtempo Ride group ride

A slow Monday night roll through downtown Phoenix that ends at a bar or restaurant. Any bike works. The route stays flat except for short ramps over the freeway. It is about an hour of riding, then hanging out.
